study_summary.objective: Compare gene expression of A. oryzae isolates with A. flavus grown on rice (from the BioProject text).
study_summary.experimental_design: RNA-seq of three A. oryzae isolates (RIB40, RIB632, RIB642) grown on rice, one library each; the rice preparation, temperature and time are not stated, and RIB642 was sequenced on a Genome Analyzer II rather than a HiSeq 2000.
study_summary.main_finding: Not available: no accession-linked paper was found, so no result is reported here.

notes: The same three isolates were also sequenced on PDA in PRJNA178638, which allows a rice versus PDA comparison per isolate only if the two sequencing batches are treated as comparable.
